raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Deployments under FIPS 140 requirements (for example FedRAMP High) need TLS performed by a FIPS-validated cryptographic module. sgl-router's TLS clients (reqwest for workers, kube-client for Kubernetes discovery) currently run on rustls with ring, which is not validated. This adds an opt-in `fips` cargo feature so those deployments can build the router with the aws-lc-rs FIPS module, without changing default builds.

## Modifications

- `Cargo.toml`: optional `aws-lc-rs` (`fips`) and `rustls` (`fips`) dependencies behind a new `fips` feature. Default builds compile neither.
- `src/main.rs`: under `cfg(feature = "fips")`, install `rustls::crypto::default_fips_provider()` as the process-wide provider at startup (reqwest and kube-client use the installed default) and refuse to start unless `aws_lc_rs::try_fips_mode()` succeeds and the provider reports FIPS.
- `src/tokenizer/adapter.rs`: in FIPS builds, refuse HuggingFace Hub tokenizer downloads with a clear error asking for `--tokenizer-path` (or `--no-tokenizer`). The hf-hub / tokenizer download path uses ureq 2 with a hardcoded ring provider that cannot be redirected to the FIPS module.
- `docker/sgl-router.Dockerfile`: `CARGO_FEATURES` build arg (the aws-lc-fips-sys toolchain — cmake, Go, clang — is installed only when `fips` is requested) and a `RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE` build arg so the runtime base can be swapped for a FIPS-mode OS image.
- `README.md`: a "FIPS builds" section (how to build, what changes, the tokenizer restriction).
- `.github/workflows/pr-test-sgl-router.yml`: one `cargo clippy --features fips -- -D warnings` step in the tier-1 lint job, so the cfg-gated FIPS code is compiled on every router PR. aws-lc-fips-sys needs cmake, Go and clang, which the GitHub-hosted Ubuntu image already has; the step adds the FIPS module build to that job (a few minutes cold, cached by rust-cache afterwards). Happy to move it to a nightly job instead if you prefer.
- `deny.toml`: allow the `OpenSSL` license used by aws-lc-fips-sys (`deny.toml` checks all features).
- `Cargo.lock`: aws-lc entries.

ring remains in the dependency graph (kube-client and the ureq-based tokenizer download pull it in) but is not used for TLS in FIPS builds.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no change to model outputs or request handling.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable for default builds (no code change without the feature). FIPS builds were exercised as below; routing overhead matched the default build.

## Testing

- Default and FIPS builds: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo check --all-targets`, `cargo check --features fips --all-targets`, clippy.
- `cargo test --test proxy`: 224/224 pass on both the default and the `fips` build.
- `tests/e2e/k8s_integration` (kind): 24/24 pass using a FIPS router image (discovery over the FIPS TLS client to the API server, lifecycle, reconciliation, shutdown drain).
- FIPS images (linux/amd64 and arm64) start with `FIPS mode: aws-lc-rs FIPS module is the rustls crypto provider` and refuse a HuggingFace repo id for the tokenizer with the new error.
- End to end on 8×B200: the FIPS router in front of SGLang engines (Inkling-Small-NVFP4 and a GLM-based model) — chat, streaming, tool calls, reasoning effort and concurrent load return the same responses as the engine directly.
- `cargo deny --all-features check`: licenses/bans/sources pass. advisories currently fail on `main` independently of this PR (RUSTSEC-2026-0433, `pulldown-cmark` 0.13.5, a build dependency of prost-build; fixed in 0.13.6).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (No new unit tests: the feature-gated startup path is exercised by the FIPS builds of the existing proxy and k8s suites above, and CI now compiles and lints the feature.)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+
       - name: cargo fmt

         run: |

@@ -25,9 +25,17 @@
 #
 # Image budget: < 100 MB stripped (M6 acceptance). Verify with
 #   `docker image inspect sgl-router:dev --format '{{.Size}}'`.
+#
+# FIPS 140-3 build (aws-lc-rs FIPS module as the TLS provider; see the `fips`
+# feature in sgl-router/Cargo.toml). The module is statically linked, so the
+# runtime image needs nothing extra; RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE may point at a FIPS
+# base for the OS packages:
+#   docker build -f docker/sgl-router.Dockerfile --build-arg CARGO_FEATURES=fips \
+#       -t sgl-router:fips .
 
 ARG RUST_VERSION=1.92
 ARG DEBIAN_VERSION=bookworm
+ARG RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE=gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
 
 ######################## STAGE 1 — chef recipe ##########################
 FROM rust:${RUST_VERSION}-${DEBIAN_VERSION} AS chef
@@ -53,8 +61,14 @@ RUN mkdir -p src sgl-kv-indexer/src/bin /work/rust/sglang-processor/src \
 
 ######################## STAGE 2 — builder ##############################
 FROM rust:${RUST_VERSION}-${DEBIAN_VERSION} AS builder
+# Comma-separated cargo features; empty for the default build. `fips` also
+# needs the aws-lc-fips-sys toolchain (cmake, Go for the delocator, clang).
+ARG CARGO_FEATURES=""
 RUN apt-get update \
     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends protobuf-compiler \
+    && case ",${CARGO_FEATURES}," in \
+         *,fips,*) apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake golang-go clang libclang-dev ;; \
+       esac \
     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
     && cargo install cargo-chef --locked --version ^0.1
 WORKDIR /work/sgl-router
@@ -79,7 +93,8 @@ RUN mkdir -p /work/rust/sglang-processor/src && touch /work/rust/sglang-processo
 # Cook (compile + cache) the dep graph from the recipe. The recipe carries every
 # workspace member's manifest and the lockfile, so chef recreates the Indexer's
 # source stubs itself.
-RUN cargo chef cook --locked --release --recipe-path recipe.json
+RUN cargo chef cook --locked --release --recipe-path recipe.json \
+    ${CARGO_FEATURES:+--features "$CARGO_FEATURES"}
 
 # Now bring in the real sources and the manifests they need.
 COPY sgl-router/Cargo.toml sgl-router/Cargo.lock ./
@@ -92,10 +107,11 @@ COPY rust/sglang-processor/src /work/rust/sglang-processor/src
 
 RUN touch sgl-kv-indexer/build.rs /work/rust/sglang-processor/src/lib.rs \
     && cargo build --locked --release --bin sgl-router \
+       ${CARGO_FEATURES:+--features "$CARGO_FEATURES"} \
     && strip target/release/sgl-router
 
 ######################## STAGE 3 — runtime ##############################
-FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot AS runtime
+FROM ${RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE} AS runtime
 
 COPY --from=builder /work/sgl-router/target/release/sgl-router /usr/local/bin/sgl-router
 
@@ -104,6 +120,7 @@ ENV SGL_ROUTER_CONFIG=/etc/sgl-router/sgl-router.yaml
 EXPOSE 8090
 
 # distroless `nonroot` runs as uid 65532. The router doesn't need root.
-USER nonroot:nonroot
+# Numeric so a RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE without a `nonroot` passwd entry still works.
+USER 65532:65532
 
 ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/sgl-router"]

+### FIPS builds
+
+For deployments that require FIPS 140-validated cryptography, build with the
+opt-in `fips` cargo feature. The router then uses the aws-lc-rs FIPS module as
+its TLS provider (outbound connections to workers and the Kubernetes API) and
+exits at startup unless FIPS mode is active. Default builds are unchanged.
+
+```bash
+cargo build --release --features fips
+# or the container image
+docker build -f docker/sgl-router.Dockerfile --build-arg CARGO_FEATURES=fips .
+```
+
+- The FIPS module builds from source and needs cmake, Go and clang, on a glibc
+  (not musl) target. The Dockerfile installs them when `fips` is requested;
+  `RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE` selects the runtime base, e.g. a FIPS-mode OS image.
+- FIPS builds do not download tokenizers from Hugging Face Hub (its HTTP
+  client cannot use the FIPS module): pass a local `--tokenizer-path`, or
+  `--no-tokenizer` for load-only policies.
+- On macOS, the FIPS module links as a shared library; set
+  `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` to its build output directory to run a native build.
+
